parts.name: Drawer (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom drawer of the storage cabinet, made of wood with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space for heavier or less frequently accessed items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Drawer (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle drawer of the storage cabinet, made of wood with a handle for easy access.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing medium-weight items that are accessed regularly.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails for smooth operation.

parts.name: Drawer (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top drawer of the storage cabinet, made of wood and equipped with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It is typically used for storing small or frequently used items for easy access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides horizontally in and out along rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of wood with a polished surface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and encloses the drawers, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides structural integrity.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom base panel of the cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides foundational support and stability to the entire cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.
